io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.payment: Standard x402: sign an EIP-3009 TransferWithAuthorization over the accepts entry and send the base64 payload in X-PAYMENT. Verified and settled through facilitator.xpay.sh in the same request, so the buyer pays no gas; the transaction hash is returned and published at /v1/settlement/{nonce}.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.paywall: The paywall is at the MCP tools/call layer. An unpaid tools/call returns a real HTTP 402 carrying the standard x402 challenge, and no work is done and nothing is charged until a payment header is presented.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.scope: Read-only. Manifests and public registry metadata only - nothing is cloned, built or executed, and no vulnerability scanning is claimed.
